title: Malaysian Braised Tagine with Broad Beans
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Malaysia, made with tender broad beans in a rich and aromatic tagine sauce.

ingredients.name: tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: a blend of cumin, coriander, turmeric, cinnamon, and chili powder

instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened (5 minutes).
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the broad beans, coconut milk, and vegetable broth.
Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until the beans are tender (20-25 minutes).
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
